steps.name: New-task provider uses a designed, accessible popup above the composer
Real profile and model catalogs populate the designed controls asynchronously
Arrow navigation is a draft until Enter commits exactly one selection
Disabled permissions remain unavailable and Escape preserves the draft
Machine popup cancels without altering machine or profile
Default profile settings popup is readable and cancels without saving
